text:
maya: Quick UX question — VoiceOver users report extra tab stops when entering the playground run area when tool-call entries are collapsed. Should we add an offscreen "Jump to latest" skiplink + aria-live updates instead of making every label tabbable? Thoughts? jesse: I lean toward skiplink + aria-live. Makes navigation faster. Discoverability is my only worry — maybe visible when focused. cc @samir for a11y take. :thinking_face: samir: Skiplink + aria-live is fine but watch focus management. Focus should be programmatic (tabindex='-1' target + focus()). VoiceOver will announce region changes if we set aria-live='polite' on the run container. Example snippet to prototype: ``` Jump to latest
Latest invocation: tool X returned output
``` That keeps tab order clean and still offers quick access. ellen: Copy nit: shorter is better for screen readers — prefer "Jump to latest" instead of "Skip to latest invocation". Also microcopy for the tool button: currently we have "Run" vs "Invoke tool" — which is clearer in the playground structured-output context? maya: Good point. Quick poll: :thumbsup: for "Run" vs :eyes: for "Invoke tool". (but prefer concise). design-bot: Accessibility checklist suggestion: ensure focused target shows visible outline; give each collapsed callstack region role="region" with aria-label like "3 tool calls, last at 10:42 AM"; announce when outputs arrive (aria-live) and avoid duplicate link/button text. Also ensure sr-only-focusable styles reveal the link on keyboard focus. jesse: Implementation note — adding tabindex='-1' to the anchor target is fine, and keeping skiplink visually hidden until focused is ideal. We should prototype without changing tab order for other interactive elements. samir: For compact callstack UI: collapse visually but expose an accessible summary (aria-hidden for visuals + sr-only text for screen readers). Example accessible summary: "3 tool calls, newest: TranslateText — success". That prevents extra navigation noise. ellen: I'll update the component copy to "Jump to latest" and adjust the tool button label to "Run tool" (middle ground). I'll add a small tooltip for sighted users explaining the keyboard shortcut. maya: Thanks — can someone open a small PR with a demo (storybook) and tag accessibility? I want to test with VoiceOver on macOS. @access-bot can you schedule a quick 15-min check tomorrow? access-bot: Quick test scheduled: 2024-04-03 10:00 PT. Invite sent to maya, samir, ellen, jesse. Reminder will go out 30m prior. maya: Awesome — when the PR is up, drop the link here and I'll run through the main flows (create tool call, collapse/expand, keyboard nav, screen reader announcements). jesse: Will do. I'll sketch the skiplink styles and attach a tiny prototype in the PR. ellen: Copy will be in the PR too. Thanks all! :rocket:
